title: pre-commit 串联 decision-gate.sh
acceptance_criteria: L1 存在性: pre-commit 包含 'decision-gate' 字符串 + tests/integration/3-modes/precommit-integration-test.sh 存在
L2 实质性: pre-commit 在 3 anti-fab 工具之后调 decision-gate.sh, 检测 commit msg 包含 'merge.*miao|push.*--force|rm -rf|reset --hard' 触发 danger.data_destruction 等, manual 模式跳过 (主公已 OK), 其它模式 ASK
L3 接线正确: KALLAX_ROOT 路径正确, decision-gate.sh exit 2 时 exit 1 阻断 commit, 不破坏现有 3 anti-fab 串联
L4 数据流动: precommit-integration-test.sh 跑 PASS, 验证 pre-commit 引用 decision-gate
